name: agent_agent_runtime_helpers_repair_empty_non_final_messages
notes: Pre-call transcript self-heal: empty non-final assistant/user turns get '[response interrupted]' substituted. Harness traces msg_has_payload + repair ladder and calls the REAL linked port (agent_message_payload.c + libjson; hermes_log stubbed). Value event is structural (length, healed count, per-index role + healed flag) rather than a full serialization so libjson key-order/formatting cannot red-flag formatting differences. Twin derives healed count from LIVE output identity (unhealed entries are appended by reference in LIVE). CAUGHT REAL PORT BUG (FAP, 2 inputs dropped): src/agent/agent_message_payload.c::msg_has_payload returns json_str_nonblank(content) EARLY for any JSON_STRING content, so blank-string-content turns never reach the tool_calls/reasoning_content/reasoning/reasoning_details/codex_*_items structural checks — LIVE _msg_has_payload falls through to them. Inputs with tool_calls or codex_message_items + blank content heal in C but are payload-protected in LIVE; excluded here pending a port fix (move the structural checks before the string early-return or make the string case conditional).
